environment: Live GitHub Pages, Chrome, synthetic data, ordinary UI actions
checks: Real GSI background tiles render behind three labelled, fictional stop pins
Selecting 中央広場 on the map and sending 駅前ロータリーへ2人 in chat updates the same selection summary
Undo restores the prior draft; selecting the destination on the map and sending 2人 completes the selection again
Review displays the selected route and passenger count before the explicit booking confirmation
Explicit confirmation saves receipt ce0fd022 for 中央広場 to 駅前ロータリー, two passengers
Driver in another tab sees the same receipt and accepts it with the stopped confirmation
The rider sees 車が確定しました with デモ車両1 and the selected boarding location
Driver records arrive, board and complete; rider chat reflects those stored states and unlocks the composer after completion
The versioned user URL opens the updated map/chat screen with no active ride remaining from this test

responsive_review.method: Same-origin iframe with explicit CSS viewport widths; visible DOM geometry and screenshot review

limitations: Responsive verification uses a desktop browser iframe, not a physical phone or Safari
The three stop names and coordinates are fictional; the dashed line is not a calculated driving route
Chat is a local parser for registered stop names and one to three passengers, not a general AI assistant
Reservation storage is local to this browser/origin and is not shared across devices
Role selection is a fictional demo identity; no production authentication, actual rides or external notifications
